Project — Edit

The Project form is used to create or edit projects for tracking income and expenses.

Projects help you monitor profitability and costs for specific jobs, contracts, or activities.

Use projects to track financial performance for individual customer relationships, specific work clusters, or time-limited contracts.

Setting Up a Project

When creating a project, provide a descriptive name that clearly identifies the project, such as 'Website Redesign for ABC Corp' or 'Q4 Marketing Campaign'.

You can optionally add an image to help visually identify the project in lists and reports.

Using Projects

After creating a project, you can assign it to transactions when recording income or expenses. This allows you to track the financial performance of each project separately.

Projects can be linked to various transaction types including Sales Invoices, Purchase Invoices, Receipts, Payments, and Purchase Orders.

To view all projects and their financial summaries, see: Projects

To view detailed profitability analysis for a project, see: Project

Name

Enter a unique name to identify this project throughout your accounting system.

Project names appear in transaction forms, financial reports, and project-specific analyses.

Use clear, descriptive names that help staff quickly identify the correct project when entering transactions.

Inactive

Check this box to mark the project as inactive when it's completed or no longer used.

Inactive projects are hidden from selection lists to reduce clutter and prevent new postings.

Historical transactions remain intact, allowing you to run reports on past project performance.

You can reactivate projects at any time by unchecking this box.
